Auto Brightness listing copy vs display engineering — two different jobs

US/EU indie teams conflate system display features with storefront language. iOS Settings and App Store Connect actually separate them:

  • Auto Brightness on the device — ambient-light sensors adjust screen brightness level so the display stays readable in dim rooms, bright sunlight, or shifting desk lighting. Toggle under Settings → Display & Brightness → Auto-Brightness. On iPhone 14 Pro and later, Ultra Auto Brightness extends the brightness range for outdoor readability. System display behavior — outside AppLocale scope.
  • Ambient-light sensor and brightness engineering — hardware integration, brightness pipeline tuning, and in-app UI that responds to Auto Brightness state. Engineering inside the binary — not listing rewrite.
  • Auto Brightness marketing on the product page — description paragraphs, subtitle positioning, keywords, promotional text, and screenshot overlays that tell buyers your app looks great with Auto Brightness enabled, respects ambient-light brightness adaptation, or pairs well with automatic screen brightness. Connect text fields — this page.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China storefront. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, and screenshot caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of how strongly your US listing markets Auto Brightness.

An app that references Auto Brightness in onboarding and a localized China listing are both valuable — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe ambient-light brightness adaptation on the store page, not whether Auto Brightness toggles inside iOS Settings.

Auto Brightness-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Ambient-light brightness marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Auto Brightness in iOS Settings — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Auto Brightness vs True Tone — do not conflate

US pages sometimes mention both Auto Brightness and True Tone on the same gallery. China storefront copy must keep them distinct: 自动亮度 / 自动调节亮度 / 环境光亮度 for brightness level under Display & Brightness → Auto-Brightness; 原彩显示 / 原彩 for all-day ambient white balance and color temperature matching. Auto Brightness changes how bright the screen is; True Tone changes how warm or cool whites appear under the same ambient light. AppLocale aligns phrasing with your actual scope — if your English source only markets Auto Brightness, we do not upgrade to True Tone 原彩显示 claims in subtitle, keywords, or overlays. See our True Tone listing guide only if white-balance marketing is your lead claim.

Official Settings vocabulary

Apple's zh-Hans Settings UI uses 自动亮度 for Auto-Brightness, with related buyer language around 自动调节亮度 (automatic brightness adjustment), 环境光亮度 (ambient-light brightness), and 屏幕亮度 (screen brightness level). Listing copy should mirror that vocabulary — not generic 背光调节 or 亮度模式 that could mean manual sliders, Night Shift warmth, or True Tone color temperature.

Ultra Auto Brightness

Recent iPhone models market an extended outdoor brightness range as Ultra Auto Brightness. zh-Hans listing copy should describe the buyer benefit — readable outdoors, brighter peak under strong ambient light — without inventing hardware claims your English source does not make. AppLocale keeps Ultra Auto Brightness phrasing aligned with your US gallery scope.

Auto Brightness vs Night Shift

Night Shift changes evening color temperature — 夜览 — not daytime brightness level. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply 夜览 when your English source only shows an Auto Brightness toggle. See the Night Shift listing guide only if evening warmth is your lead marketing claim.

Auto Brightness vs Dark Mode

Dark Mode changes UI chrome from light to dark — 深色模式. Auto Brightness adjusts brightness level regardless of appearance mode. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply 深色模式 when your English source only shows an Auto Brightness toggle. See the Dark Mode listing guide only if appearance themes are your lead marketing claim.

Auto Brightness vs Display Zoom and Accessibility Zoom

Display Zoom changes UI scale — 显示缩放. Accessibility Zoom magnifies the screen under Accessibility settings. Auto Brightness adjusts brightness level under Display & Brightness. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply 显示缩放 or 放大功能 when your English source only shows an Auto Brightness toggle. See the Display Zoom listing guide only if UI scale presets are your lead marketing claim.

Terms like 自动亮度, 环境光亮度, and 屏幕亮度 each signal different intent from generic productivity keywords or True Tone 原彩显示 terms.

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Screen brightness adapts to room light" headlines on gallery frames showing Settings → Display & Brightness → Auto-Brightness — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. AppLocale FAQ

Is Auto Brightness the same as True Tone on the listing?

No. Auto Brightness markets automatic screen brightness level under ambient light — 自动亮度, 自动调节亮度, 环境光亮度. True Tone markets all-day ambient white balance and color temperature matching — 原彩显示. Auto Brightness changes how bright the screen is; True Tone changes how warm or cool whites appear. See our True Tone listing guide for white-balance copy.

Is Auto Brightness the same as Night Shift?

No. Auto Brightness adjusts screen brightness level based on ambient light. Night Shift markets scheduled evening warmth and reduced blue light — 夜览. See our Night Shift listing guide for evening warmth copy.

Is Auto Brightness the same as Dark Mode?

No. Auto Brightness adjusts display brightness level to match ambient light. Dark Mode markets light/dark UI appearance — 深色模式. Auto Brightness can run in either appearance mode. See our Dark Mode listing guide for appearance theme copy.

Is Auto Brightness the same as Display Zoom or Accessibility Zoom?

No. Auto Brightness is under Display & Brightness and adjusts brightness level. Display Zoom changes UI scale — 显示缩放. Accessibility Zoom magnifies the screen under Accessibility settings. See our Display Zoom listing guide for UI scale copy.
